run_configure_script: run the configure script to set up Bazel build parameters for the launchpad workspace
setup_python_paths: setup python binary and library paths for Bazel configuration
reset_bazelrc_config: reset the .launchpad.bazelrc configuration file to a clean state
write_bazelrc_settings: write build and action environment variables to the .launchpad.bazelrc file
run_shell_command: run a shell command and capture its output as a decoded string
